Name: (STF) Pierre Sells Strawberry Seeds
Author: invatorzen
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/Yk1pqXb.png[/img]﻿[/center][center]
[size=3]Have you ever wanted Pierre to sell Strawberry Seeds for the whole season of Spring? Well, now he does!

This simple mod [b]requires[/b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5005]Shop Tile Framework[/url]﻿ and was a request on [url=https://github.com/StardewModders/mod-ideas/issues/801]github[/url]﻿.

They are sold for the same price as they would be at the Egg Festival. (100 gold)[/size][/center]
